put.description:
ViewSet for managing subscriptions.

Provides operations for subscriptions:
- List all subscriptions (admin) or user's own subscriptions
- Retrieve a subscription
- Create a new subscription (parent subscribing to a plan)
- Update subscription status (admin only)

Permissions:
- All actions require authentication
- Admin can see all subscriptions, users see only their own
- Only admin can update/delete subscriptions

For security reasons, always returns 200 even if email is not found.

API endpoint to verify OTP during password reset.

If OTP is valid, returns a temporary reset token to be used

post.description:
Creates a new user account with the provided information.

Behavior:
• Account is created with `is_active=False`
• Parent role assigned by default
• A 6-digit OTP code is generated
• An email containing the OTP code is sent

The user will need to verify this code using the verification endpoint to activate their account.

201.description: Registration successful - account created (inactive) and OTP sent via email

post.description: Takes a valid refresh token and returns a new access token (and optionally a new refresh token). This is the standard way to keep the user session alive without requiring re-authentication.

post.description:
Webhook to receive PayPal payment notifications.

POST /api/subscriptions/webhook/paypal/

PayPal will send events like:
- PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED
- PAYMENT.SALE.DENIED
- PAYMENT.SALE.REFUNDED

Webhook to receive Stripe payment notifications.

POST /api/subscriptions/webhook/stripe/

Stripe will send events like:
- checkout.session.completed
- payment_intent.succeeded
- payment_intent.payment_failed

Webhook to receive Taramoney payment notifications.

POST /api/subscriptions/webhook/taramoney/

Expected body from Taramoney:
{
    "merchant_id": "xxx",
    "order_id": "payment-uuid",
    "transaction_id": "TARA123456",
    "status": "SUCCESS" | "FAILED" | "CANCELLED",
    "amount": "10000.00",
    "currency": "XAF",
    "signature": "hmac-signature"
}

or was not received.

SubscriptionCreate.description:
Serializer for creating a new subscription (parent subscribing to a plan).

This handles the initial subscription without payment processing.
The payment will be handled separately through payment endpoints.

plan.title: Unique ID
plan.description: The plan to subscribe to (must be an active plan)

SubscriptionDetail.description:
Serializer for detailed subscription view.

Includes complete subscription information with related payments.

end_date.description: When the subscription ends (null if still active)

SubscriptionList.description:
Serializer for listing subscriptions.

Provides overview of subscriptions with user and plan information.

end_date.description: When the subscription ends (null if still active)

VerifyEmail.description:

Validates the OTP code sent to user's email and activates the account.
